 Pakistan Bowl Out Sri Lanka for 98 in Rawalpindi Test
 Pakistan bowled out Sri Lanka for 98 in the Rawalpindi Test and then reached 121 for three in reply.
 Online Desk Report
 Published: 17 November 2026, 9:46 pm 
 · 1 min read 
 A− 
 A+ 
 Pakistan players celebrate a Sri Lankan wicket in the Rawalpindi Test 
 Pakistan bowled out Sri Lanka for 98 in 35.3 overs in the Rawalpindi Test, with three bowlers taking three wickets each.
 Mohammad Abbas took three for 14, Razaullah three for 21 and Jamal three for 24.
 Kusal Mendis top-scored for Sri Lanka with 32, while Sonal Dinusha made 21.
 In reply, Pakistan reached 121 for three. The openers put on 80 for the first wicket, with Tayyab Arif scoring 46 and Awais unbeaten on 47.
 Babar Azam was bowled by Lahiru Kumara for eight.
 The first Test of the series ended in a draw.
